title: Rest & Restore: A Winter Sound Bath
seo_title: Rest & Restore: A Winter Sound Bath at The Farmstead
description: Rest & Restore is a winter sound healing session led by Certified Sound Healer, Yoga Teacher & Transformational Coach Leslie Smith, featuring crystal bowls, gongs, drums, chimes, and other instruments to help you slow down, breathe deeply, and release stress. Attendees are invited to bring a yoga mat, blanket, or anything else that helps them get comfortable. It takes place Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM at The Farmstead.
